description.p: LyricsLens reads what your music player is playing, finds the lyrics on LRCLIB, and shows the line being sung on top of everything on your screen, a film or game in fullscreen included.

ul.li: Follows the song by itself, from any player that reports its position
Karaoke mode fills the line as it is sung
Font, colour, size and position are yours to set
Lyrics already found work without internet
Wrong lyrics can be corrected by hand, and the choice is kept

description.p: Staying above fullscreen windows needs a desktop with the layer-shell protocol: Hyprland, Sway, KDE Plasma, COSMIC and niri have it. On GNOME it shows in a normal window instead. Songs playing in Firefox cannot be followed, because Firefox does not report how far into the song it is.

description.p: Spanish joins English and Portuguese, and a language can be added from a file.
